intro: This page lists the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Punjab by the average packages in our records. We currently link {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} public colleges.
IIM Amritsar is the national institute on this list, with NIPER Mohali and several state engineering-college MBA programmes. Packages are historical records from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
listLead: IIM Amritsar appears first. The first-colleges table may show the Master of Human Resource Management rather than the flagship MBA, so read the programme name before you compare fees or packages.
snapshot: For colleges with a recorded average package, the median is {{pkgMedian}}, and the highest recorded average is {{pkgMax}}. The recorded years run from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
The lowest averages in our file look too thin to treat as a reliable floor, so read each official report when you compare top MBA / PGDM colleges in Punjab 2026.
firstCollegesLead: IIM Amritsar has a 2024 recorded average of ₹20 LPA and a highest of ₹59 LPA. In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Amritsar is 64, which may differ from an older number on a card.
Sant Longowal Institute and the School of Management Studies, Patiala, have recorded averages of ₹5 LPA. Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College's figure is from 2020, so treat it as an old record.

compare.heading: How to compare the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Punjab
paragraphs: IIM Amritsar's MBA and its HRM programme are not the same product as an MBA at a state engineering college. Compare the award, the year and the official report.
